page_title: NIC 2-1 REI | Nice v Reims 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
90+1' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) takes the corner but it's cleared.
90+1' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+1' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
90' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Romain Perraud (Nice) replaces Jeremie Boga.
89' Evann Guessand (Nice) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
88' That will be all from Thibault De Smet who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Amine Salama (Reims).
86' Azor Matusiwa (Reims) was probably a bit loose with his words to Benoit Bastien, who decides to show him a yellow.
86' Melvin Bard (Nice) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.
84' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Pablo Rosario and he is replaced by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
84' Substitution. Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) in, Morgan Sanson out.
84' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
84' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) picked up a yellow card from referee.
82' 2 - 1 Jeremie Boga (Nice) struck from medium range. He smashed the ball inside the left post. What a hit! Pure magic.
81' The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.

81' Pablo Rosario (Nice) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, Yehvann Diouf shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
80' The referee blows his whistle, Nice are awarded a corner kick.
80' Dante (Nice) is able to continue to play.
79' Dante (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
78' 1 - 1 Goal! Junya Ito swings the ball deep into the box and finds Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
76' One of the players from Nice times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
76' Francesco Farioli prepares a substitution. Gaetan Laborde is replaced by Evann Guessand (Nice).
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Oumar Diakite (Reims) for Mohamed Daramy.
75' The linesman raises his flag. Thibault De Smet (Reims) is adjudged offside.
72' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
70' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Daramy (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
68' Teddy Teuma (Reims) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
68' Reims will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
68' That's the end of the game for Amir Richardson, who is replaced by Keito Nakamura (Reims).
68' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Reda Khadra (Reims) replacing Thomas Foket.

67' OFF THE BAR! Junya Ito (Reims) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
65' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Yehvann Diouf.
61' The foul by Thomas Foket (Reims) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Benoit Bastien.
61' Dante (Nice) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Bastien has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
60' Morgan Sanson (Nice) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
60' Pablo Rosario (Nice) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.
59' The Reims players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
55' 1 - 0 Gaetan Laborde (Nice) blasts the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and his effort goes in off the crossbar to give the goalkeeper no chance!
54' Azor Matusiwa (Reims) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
53' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle after Melvin Bard (Nice) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
53' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
50' Jeremie Boga (Nice) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
49' Morgan Sanson (Nice) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
48' Pablo Rosario (Nice) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' Benoit Bastien has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
42' Terem Moffi (Nice) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
41' The ball is out of play. Nice will have a throw-in.
39' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Morgan Sanson (Nice) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
36' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is penalised for a foul. Benoit Bastien had a clear view and blows his whistle.
35' Jeremie Boga (Nice) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
34' Great teamplay by Reims as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

31' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benoit Bastien with no other option than to blow for a foul. Reims earn a free kick.
30' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Nice out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
29' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
27' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the right post.
25' Jeremie Boga (Nice) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
24' PENALTY APPEAL after Teddy Teuma (Reims) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
23' Nice are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
20' The flag is raised and Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is offside again, not for the first time today.
18' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
18' Terem Moffi (Nice) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
16' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Gaetan Laborde (Nice) heads on.
15' A player from Nice brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
13' Morgan Sanson (Nice) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
11' A rebound spins to Morgan Sanson (Nice) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
11' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
10' Terem Moffi (Nice) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
9' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
8' Morgan Sanson (Nice) steps up to send the ball in.
8' Terem Moffi (Nice) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Nice.
6' Jeremie Boga (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' The resulting corner from Jeremie Boga (Nice) is cleared.
5' Jeremie Boga (Nice) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Morgan Sanson (Nice) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nice.
4' Morgan Sanson (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Bastien interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
2' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nice will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien is the one to supervise the game today.
